axes.model_access: MiniMax’s in-house speech line: speech-2.8-hd/2.8-turbo, speech-2.6-hd/2.6-turbo and speech-02-hd/02-turbo. The API overview lists 40 languages and 300+ system voices, plus voice cloning and voice design asset lines. Paid music-generation APIs closed to new users on 2026-08-20, while Music 3 open weights live on Hugging Face/ModelScope (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: MiniMax Audio web (hailuoai.com/audio and minimax.io/audio) plus the open-platform API (platform.minimaxi.com); cloud synthesis with synchronous HTTP/WebSocket and asynchronous long-text channels, and speech APIs are stateless by design (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: No local model: clone audio is uploaded for a `file_id`, async long-text jobs return `task_id` → `file_id`, and download URLs are valid for nine hours from issue; web works and voices stay account-side. Music models additionally offer open weights for local runs (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Synchronous T2A handles up to 10,000 characters per call with real-time streaming; asynchronous T2A handles up to one million characters, returns a `task_id`, and exposes a `file_id` for the file API after polling, with sentence-level timestamps. Neither channel depends on the local machine being online (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: TTS (40 languages, 300+ voices, volume/pitch/speed, proportional mixing, mp3/pcm/flac/wav), fast voice cloning (mono/dual channel, optional prompt audio), voice design from a prompt, async long text with subtitle timestamps and an official MCP covering speech, cloning, video and music (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Stateless APIs: official docs say a single call processes only the supplied content, stores no user data and involves no business-logic state. Voice assets (`voice_id`) provide cross-request consistency rather than session memory, and cloned/designed voices are deleted if unused for seven days (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Accounts plus API keys; voice cloning requires personal real-name or enterprise verification, consistent across the FAQ and API docs. Customer content must be owned or licensed, output responsibility rests with the user, and the agreement permits de-identified, non-reidentifiable use of inputs/outputs for service optimisation and security (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: high-quality Chinese/multilingual TTS, cloning one’s own voice, long-form audiobooks (async plus subtitles), API integration and domestic direct access. Not fit: cloning others (a consent red line), open-weight speech models or offline TTS (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official API overview, speech-synthesis and voice-cloning docs, and the user agreement. Clone similarity, long-text stability and web/API model parity need account-level measurement.

Also cloning-oriented: fish audio leans on its community voice library, MiniMax on its official voice library + API.
Same vendor, different product line: Hailuo Video is the video line, this dossier is the audio line.
